rl.user_model_rpm: Requests per minute per user per model

site.title: 1–64 characters.
site.server_address: Used as the Base URL for token snippets and callback links.
site.footer_html: Allowed tags: a, p, br, strong, em.
site.about_html: Allowed tags: a, p, br, strong, em.
site.home_custom_html: Custom HTML fully takes over the homepage render. Maximum 65,536 characters.

console.require_auth: Always on. The console requires sign-in.

modules.console: Keys follow the console routes; tokens is the API-token module.

auth.signup_enabled: New users cannot register themselves while this is off.
auth.password_login_enabled: At least one sign-in method must be enabled.
auth.email_verification_required: Requires SMTP to be configured, otherwise verification mail cannot be sent.
auth.email_domain_allowlist: Press Enter or separate entries with commas. Wildcards such as *.edu.cn are supported.

turnstile.secret_key: Leave empty to keep the current secret.

billing.quota_per_unit: Changing this affects top-ups and how balances are displayed.
billing.display_unit: Consumption is always accounted in credits.
billing.free_model_preconsume_multiplier: Must be greater than 0 (values ≤ 0 are rejected; default 1).
billing.free_model_preconsume_trust_credits: Users above this lifetime spend skip pre-consumption; 0 pre-consumes for everyone.

pay.online_enabled: Turning this off hides every online payment method. Redemption codes are unaffected.

stripe.secret_key: Starts with sk_. Leave empty to keep the current key.
stripe.webhook_secret: Starts with whsec_. Leave empty to keep the current secret.

alipay.private_key: PEM encoded. Leave empty to keep the current key.
alipay.public_key: PEM encoded. Leave empty to keep the current key.

epay.api_url: Must be an absolute https URL, at most 1024 characters.
epay.key: Signs orders and verifies callbacks. Leave empty to keep the current key.
epay.sign_mode: append: signature string + key (standard). amp: signature string & key (some gateways). Orders and callbacks must use the same mode.
epay.notify_url: Optional absolute https URL. Derived from the service address when empty.
epay.return_url: Optional absolute URL or site-relative path for the browser return.

rl.group_overrides: JSON object mapping group names to RPM, e.g. {"vip": 1200}.

ssrf.enabled: Applies to all outbound requests: OAuth discovery, webhooks, payment callbacks, URL health checks, and upstream channel forwarding.
ssrf.domain_list: One domain per line or comma-separated. In allowlist mode an empty list blocks every outbound request.
ssrf.mode: off disables every outbound check; basic blocks private and loopback targets; strict also requires the resolved address to be public. The default domain mode is allowlist — a breaking tightening (G-DOM-68): only listed hosts are reachable, so add every webhook, payment callback and OAuth discovery host before upgrading.
ssrf.domain_mode: Default allowlist is a breaking tightening (G-DOM-68): outbound requests to hosts not on the list are blocked.

sensitive.scope: Choose which prompt fields are inspected.
sensitive.words: One word per line. The wildcard * is supported.
sensitive.action: Block rejects the request; log forwards it and records the match.

smtp.from_email: Falls back to the sender account when empty.
smtp.from_name: Falls back to the site title when empty.
smtp.insecure_skip_verify: For debugging only. Never use this in production.

webhook.url: Must be an absolute https URL, at most 1024 characters.
webhook.secret: Used for the HMAC-SHA256 signature header X-NewTG-Signature. Leave empty to keep the current value.
webhook.events: Only the selected events are delivered.
webhook.events_empty: No events subscribed. Nothing will be delivered.
webhook.balance_low_threshold: 0 disables low-balance scanning. Requires the Webhook switch and the balance_low event subscription.

rl_health.auto_disable_enabled: A channel is disabled on the first match; there is no failure-count threshold.
rl_health.response_time_threshold_seconds: This is a response-time threshold, not a failure count.
rl_health.disable_keywords: Response bodies containing any of these keywords disable the channel.
rl_health.auto_enable_enabled: Only the periodic health check can restore automatically disabled channels; manually disabled channels are never restored.

checkin.min_quota: 0 stops rewards: check-ins are recorded without credits or ledger rows. The maximum is ignored.
checkin.max_quota: Must be greater than or equal to the minimum.
